outcome: Neonatal morbidity (assessed using the Morbidity Assessment Index for Newborns (MAIN) score)
Emergency Cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: 126 small-for-gestational-age (SGA) singleton fetuses with normal umbilical artery Doppler indices delivered after 34 weeks' gestation
finding: In late-onset SGA fetuses with normal umbilical artery Doppler indices, the presence of signs of placental underperfusion (PUP) was significantly associated with increased neonatal morbidity.
